messages:
Maya Singh: Uploaded a new concept for the org member page: compact table view + an inline invite preview drawer (opens from the top-right). Figma: https://figma.com/s/unique_mock (layer: org-members-compact). Looking for quick UX + a11y take.

Alex Park: Nice direction. Couple quick asks: show an SSO chip next to SSO-only accounts, and change the member action label from 'Remove user' to 'Revoke access'.

Jonah Lee: Backend note: for invite preview we should use POST /orgs/:id/invites?preview=true so we render the email without generating tokens. We'll also add deep-link params for audit: /orgs/:id/audit?actor={user_id}&event={event}.

Priya Rao: Accessibility checklist items: drawer must trap focus, focus should land on the drawer title, and the rest of the page should get aria-hidden. Announce drawer open with an aria-live polite region. Role dropdowns need keyboard nav (Arrow keys, Home/End) and a visible 3:1 contrast focus ring.

Maya Singh: Copy options for the invite CTA inside the preview drawer: 'Send invitation' (admin-action), 'Preview invitation' (read-only), or 'Send and close'. I think primary should be 'Send invitation'. Thoughts?

Eli (PM): Use 'Send invitation' as primary. For the email body, prefer 'Accept invitation' as the action link text for recipients. Keep the subject short: 'Invitation to join {org-name}'. Add SSO line only when org.require_sso is true: 'If your org requires single sign-on (SSO), you'll be routed to your provider on accept.'

Alex Park: Also add an inline small confirmation banner when toggling 'Require SSO' that reads: 'SSO enforcement enabled. Non-SSO logins will be blocked.' Make it dismissible and add aria-live announcement when toggled.

Jonah Lee: We'll gate the toggle behind a feature flag and emit analytics: ui.org.invite.preview_open, ui.org.invite.sent, ui.org.sso.toggled. I'll also add a retry link if the migration job for enabling SSO fails.

Priya Rao: For the compact table, ensure each row has role=\"row\" and aria-rowindex set. Role changes should trigger a live announcement like 'Role updated: {name} is now {role}.' Also ensure the SSO chip has accessible text: 'SSO-only account'.

Maya Singh: UI nit: when showing the audit link on a member row, have the tooltip 'View activity' and deep-link to /orgs/:id/audit?actor={user_id}. We'll add a small icon button in the actions column.

Alex Park: Microcopy tweak: change any 'Remove access' strings to 'Revoke access' across UI and emails. Also make the invite expiration text explicit: 'This link expires in 7 days.'

Eli (PM): Final rollout plan: ship behind feature flag, run a small internal beta, collect a11y test results. Priya, can you draft 2-3 acceptance tests for screen readers?

Priya Rao: Yes. I'll post the a11y test cases in #eng-qa: open drawer announce, role change announce, sso toggle announce. Also include keyboard-only navigation flows for compact table.

DesignBot: Updated mock with focus outline adjustments and a11y annotations. Layer: compact-table-a11y.

DeployBot: Heads up: design tokens update deploying to staging in 20m. If you need the updated focus styles in staging today, delay merging style changes.

Alex Park: Good call. Next steps: Maya finalizes mocks and copy, Jonah wires preview flag + deep-links + analytics, Priya posts a11y checks, Eli coordinates feature flag rollout. I'll do a final copy pass. Ping me for microcopy pairing. :thumbsup:
